text:
Maya Chen: Ping — canary promo stuck, deploy-bot paused. Seeing CI fail and artifact fetch errors.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for canary-2026-03-21.
Reason: artifact_mirror_fetch_failed (mirror-2 TTL expired) + pipeline test failure.

Maya Chen: stacktrace from CI:
``` 
AssertionError: expected column 'user_id' in migration 20260321_add_users
...integration_tests/test_migrations.py:42
``` 

Priya Singh: hmm test failure looks like schema didn't apply on the canary DB, could be the migration container image missing.

ci-bot: fetch error log:
```
GET https://mirror-2.internal.redwood/artifacts/canary-2026-03-21.tar.gz -> 404 Not Found
cache-control: max-age=0, stale-if-error=300
``` 

Theo Patel: Mirror 2 TTL was recently rotated; ops said it reindexed yesterday. @Samir R can you confirm mirror sync? :eyes:

Samir R: looking now, mirror-2 reindex job failed mid-sync (OOM). artifacts for that window are missing. Ops is restarting reindex.

Maya Chen: decision needed — do we roll back the canary or pin to previous artifact and promote? We have customers on canary.

Priya Singh: prefer pin to previous image (canary-2026-03-20) and unpause later. Migration might have partial applied state, so safer to pin and re-run migration in staging.

Theo Patel: agree. Plan: pin route to canary-2026-03-20, abort current promo, create follow-up to re-run reindex and re-run CI. I'll create the PR and release note update.

Maya Chen: ok do it. @deploy-bot abort-promotion canary-2026-03-21 and promote canary-2026-03-20 manually.

deploy-bot: Promotion abort initiated. Rolling back to previous pinned image per manual override.

Maya Chen: filing issue for mirror reindex + add alert for mirror sync failures. link: https://redwood.company/issue/RI-435

Priya Singh: added a quick postmortem doc in /docs/releases/canary-mirror-ttl-incident.md — will update once reindex completes. :white_check_mark:

Samir R: reindex job restarted, ETA ~12m. I'll notify when artifacts are available.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. We'll re-run the promo after reindex and green CI.
